title: Grocery tools to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established supermarket and delivery patterns when you are modelling everyday food sourcing alongside international pantry needs. Confirm coverage and world-food stock on each site — this block is not a ranking of specialty markets.

items.reason: Full-service benchmark with world-food aisles in many larger branches — useful when modelling weekly international top-ups beside everyday staples.
App-based grocery delivery — search world-food lines for your postcode and compare fees with a specialty market trip when time-poor weeks tempt convenience.
Meal kits for predictable dinners — compare with cooking from aisle staples plus occasional specialty ingredients before treating kits as a pantry replacement.
